title: 下向きノズルの壁掛けハンドドライヤー
description: 公共トイレの壁面向けの静的なハンドドライヤー。丸みのある外殻、実際に開いた下面ノズルと吸気格子、センサー風部品、背面固定板と配線入口を造形。壁や電源配線は含みません。送風・加熱・衛生効果はなく、衛生・電気・安全認証はありません。配置時は壁面からの距離と取付高さを調整してください。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.270 × 0.302 × 0.223 m、11,924三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A static wall hand-dryer prop for public washroom scenes, with a rounded shell, genuinely open downward outlet, separated intake slats, sensor-like insert, rear mount and cable inlet. Wall and power wiring are absent. It provides no airflow, heat or hygiene effect and has no hygiene, electrical or safety certification. Adjust wall offset and installation height in the target scene. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.270 × 0.302 × 0.223 m; 11,924 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
